title: pollardia concolor
intro: Pollardia concolor, commonly known as the "Benguet tea plant," is a species of flowering plant native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to make a traditional tea that has been consumed for centuries. The health benefits of Pollardia concolor tea include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of certain diseases and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
